flagged.evidence: The definition says, “If X is a vector space of functions on the reference cell containing P and each degree of freedom has a well-defined bounded linear extension to X,” but gives X no norm or topology. Boundedness of a linear map is undefined for a bare vector space, so this condition does not define when the interpolation operator is available.

The statement allows N∈N₀, including N=0, while step 2.1 concludes that finitely many nodal evaluations have a common bound “by taking the maximum of their constants.” For the empty node list that maximum is undefined; the conclusion is vacuous and needs a separate empty case.
